scripts.update:data: npm run update:data:notes && npm run update:data:tasks && npm run update:data:posts
scripts.update:data:notes: npm run update:data:notes:collect && npm run update:data:notes:update
scripts.update:data:notes:collect: npm run obsidian:setup && ob sync --path ./tmp/vault > /dev/null && mkdir -p ./tmp/notes-history && touch ./tmp/notes-history/$(date "+%Y-%m-%d").txt && ls './tmp/vault/🪶 Fleeting' > ./tmp/notes-history/$(date "+%Y-%m-%d").txt
scripts.obsidian:setup: ob login --email $OBSIDIAN_EMAIL --password $OBSIDIAN_PASSWORD && ob sync-setup --vault 'Notes' --path ./tmp/vault --password $OBSIDIAN_PASSWORD && ob sync-config --path ./tmp/vault --mode mirror-remote
scripts.update:data:tasks: npm run update:data:tasks:collect && npm run update:data:tasks:update
scripts.update:data:tasks:collect: mkdir -p tmp && td auth token --credential-store=plaintext $TODOOIST_AUTH_TOKEN; timestamp=$(date "+%Y-%m-%d") && td activity --since $timestamp | grep completed | grep task | wc -l > tmp/tasks-completed
